blocks.source: 英雄伝説6 空の軌跡
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes VI: Trails in the Sky

blocks.source: 本作はＦＣ、ＳＣ、３ｒｄの３作品に分かれて販売されていることが特徴。３作品で一作品としてレビューする。
blocks.translation: This game is notable for being sold as three separate titles: FC, SC, and the 3rd. I will review all three as a single game.

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: ストーリーは王道で上質。小さな町から旅立った主人公達が国家規模の大騒動に巻き込まれていく。物語の内容には複数の国家・組織が関わってくるが、舞台となるのは１つの王国に限られる。
blocks.translation: The story is classic and high-quality. The protagonists leave a small town and become embroiled in a massive national incident. Although multiple countries and organizations are involved in the story, the setting is limited to a single kingdom.

blocks.source: 物語としては、ＦＣとＳＣの二作品で完結。ただし、回収しない伏線も多いので『零の奇跡』など後の続編への展開をうかがわせる。
blocks.translation: The story concludes across the two titles FC and SC. However, since many plot threads are left unresolved, it hints at developments in later sequels such as Trails from Zero.

blocks.source: ていうか、ＲＰＧ史上稀に見る凄まじい大風呂敷ぶりで、３作品を掛けてなお、敵組織の全貌が見えない。後のシリーズでもちゃんと伏線回収できるのかと心配になる。
blocks.translation: In fact, it is an astonishingly ambitious setup, rarely seen in RPG history; even after spanning three titles, the full picture of the enemy organization remains unclear. It makes me wonder whether the later games in the series will properly resolve all the foreshadowing.

blocks.source: 一般兵などモブキャラとの会話までもが作りこまれているのが作品の特徴。丁寧とも言えるし、反面冗長とも言えなくもない。
blocks.translation: One distinctive feature of the game is how much even conversations with generic soldiers and other minor characters are fleshed out. You could call it meticulous, though on the other hand, you could also say it is somewhat verbose.

blocks.source: 例えば、門番との会話の例。
blocks.translation: For example, here is a conversation with a gatekeeper.

blocks.source: ●このゲームの場合
blocks.translation: ● In this game

blocks.source: 主人公「すみません。この先の○○○○に行きたいんですけど。
blocks.translation: Protagonist: “Excuse me. I’d like to go to ○○○○ up ahead, but…”

blocks.source: 門番「ごめんね。実は××××な事情で通れないんです。
blocks.translation: Gatekeeper: “Sorry. Actually, you can’t pass because of a ×××× situation.”

blocks.source: 主人公「えっ！ そうなんですか？
blocks.translation: Protagonist: “Huh! Really?”

blocks.source: 門番「もし○○○○に行きたいなら、△△△△を通って行くといいですよ。
blocks.translation: Gatekeeper: “If you want to go to ○○○○, you should take △△△△.”

blocks.source: 主人公「△△△△ですね。どうもありがとうございます。
blocks.translation: Protagonist: “△△△△, right? Thank you very much.”

blocks.source: ●参考：サガシリーズの場合（これが書きたかっただけ。）
blocks.translation: ● For reference: In the SaGa series (I just wanted to write this.)

blocks.source: 門番「かえれ！
blocks.translation: Gatekeeper: “Go away!”

blocks.source: ３ｒｄはなぜか一転ダンジョンRPGになっていて、ストーリー性は薄い。いかにも低予算。
blocks.translation: For some reason, the 3rd suddenly becomes a dungeon RPG, and its story is thin. It unmistakably feels low-budget.

blocks.source: かといって、その乏しいストーリーを無視すると後の作品へ繋がらないのは困りもの。ＦＣ・ＳＣでは必要以上に丁寧な部分が多かったのに、ここで手を抜くなんて……。
blocks.translation: Even so, ignoring that meager story makes it impossible to connect to the later titles, which is a problem. FC and SC had many parts that were more painstakingly detailed than necessary, yet they cut corners here…

blocks.source: システム・バランス
blocks.translation: Systems and Balance

blocks.source: 強化システムであるオーブメントは複雑な作り。まず、このゲームにはクオーツと呼ばれる能力アップなどの効果を持った装備品（複数装備可能）がある。さらにそれは属性値と呼ばれる７属性分の値を持っており、装備したクオーツの属性値の合計が一定になれば魔法が使えるようになるという難解な仕組みである。
blocks.translation: The Orbment enhancement system is complex. First, this game has equipment called quartz that provides effects such as ability boosts, and multiple pieces can be equipped. Each quartz also has values for seven attributes, and once the total attribute values of the equipped quartz reach certain amounts, you can use magic. It is an intricate system.

blocks.source: ただクオーツと魔法のどちらも役立つ物、役立たない物の差が極端なため「精神」「ＨＰ」「駆動」「行動力」……のように決まりきった組み合わせになりがち。
blocks.translation: However, the difference between useful and useless quartz and magic is extreme, so you tend to end up with fixed combinations such as “Mind,” “HP,” “Cast,” and “Action…”

blocks.source: クオーツの作成にはセピスという７属性の石が必要となっている。倒す敵によって、手に入るセピスの属性が異なるため、シンボルエンカウントであることを利用して、狙ったセピス・クオーツを手に入れることができる。
blocks.translation: Creating quartz requires sepith, stones representing the seven attributes. Since the type of sepith obtained differs depending on the enemy defeated, you can take advantage of the symbol encounters to obtain the sepith and quartz you want.

blocks.source: ……とそこだけ見ると優れたシステムの様に思えるけど、イベント進行に伴い必要なクオーツは宝箱などから普通に手に入る。そこがちょっと物足りない。
blocks.translation: Looking at just that, it seems like an excellent system, but the quartz you need as events progress can ordinarily be obtained from treasure chests and the like. That is a little unsatisfying.

blocks.source: ※ごちゃごちゃ言ってますが、発想自体はかなり好きです。筆者も自作品で真似してます。
blocks.translation: ※ I’m rambling, but I really like the concept itself. I’ve even imitated it in my own game.

blocks.source: また、上級の攻撃魔法を覚えても威力がほとんど変わらない。にも関わらず消費ＥＰ（ＭＰに相当）は大幅増加し、詠唱時間は長くなるため、本当にダメージ効率が上がっているか疑問が生じる。確実に意味があるのは効果範囲が広くなる魔法についてのみ。
blocks.translation: Furthermore, even when you learn advanced attack magic, its power barely changes. Despite this, EP consumption (equivalent to MP) increases substantially and casting time becomes longer, raising doubts about whether its damage efficiency has actually improved. The only magic that definitely has a meaningful benefit is magic with a wider area of effect.

blocks.source: 回復補助魔法が非常に強力であるため、難易度は低め。というか、敵の攻撃を１回完全に防ぐ複数・全体掛け魔法がほとんどデメリットもなく使えてしまうとか、何たるヌルゲー。
blocks.translation: The healing and support magic is extremely powerful, so the difficulty is on the low side. I mean, you can use magic that completely blocks an enemy attack once, against multiple targets or the entire party, with practically no drawbacks. What an absurdly easy game.

blocks.source: 装備品も適当にやっていればその時点で売っている最強装備が整う。丁寧に誘導されているがゆえに快適だけど、試行錯誤する楽しみも薄れているのは、ゲームバランスの難しいところ……。
blocks.translation: If you make even a halfhearted effort with equipment, you will end up with the strongest equipment available at that point. It is comfortable because the game guides you so carefully, but the fact that it diminishes the fun of trial and error is the difficult part of game balance…

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポはやや遅めでもっさりだけど、致命的なレベルではない。ただなんというか、ぬるいゲームバランスに、心地よいＢＧＭと合わさって、眠たくなってくるのは僕だけ？
blocks.translation: The battle tempo is somewhat slow and sluggish, though not to a fatal degree. Still, is it just me, or do the easy game balance and pleasant BGM together make you feel sleepy?

blocks.source: 「宝箱モンスター」「ストーリー進行上での敵兵との戦い」などザコ相手の強制戦闘が多め。個人的には、宝箱モンスターはＤＱ３のピラミッドの人喰い箱のようにプレイヤーをアッと驚かせてこそ価値があると思っているけれど、ちょっと多すぎじゃないかな～と。
blocks.translation: There are quite a few forced battles against weak enemies, such as “treasure chest monsters” and “battles against enemy soldiers required for story progression.” Personally, I think treasure chest monsters have value when they surprise the player, like the man-eating chests in the pyramid in Dragon Quest III, but aren’t there just a little too many of them?

blocks.source: エンカウント方式はシンボルエンカウントを採用している。ただ、歩行時にパーティメンバー４人全員が常に表示されており、後ろのメンバーに敵が触れた場合でも戦闘になってしまう仕様のため、敵に追跡された場合の回避はシビア。
blocks.translation: The game uses symbol encounters. However, all four party members are always displayed while walking, and the game enters battle even when an enemy touches a member at the back. As a result, avoiding enemies when they pursue you is difficult.

blocks.source: もっとも、中盤以降は敵シンボルがこちらを追尾しないようにするクオーツがあるため、問題なくなる。
blocks.translation: That said, from the middle of the game onward, there is quartz that prevents enemy symbols from chasing you, so this ceases to be a problem.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: グラフィックは独特。美麗３ＤＣＧとも２Ｄドット絵とも異なるので、何となく家庭用ゲーム機のＲＰＧばかりやっている人間にとっては違和感あるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: The graphics are distinctive. They are neither beautiful 3D CG nor 2D pixel art, so people who mainly play console RPGs may find them somewhat unfamiliar.

blocks.source: 戦闘演出はそれなりに頑張っているが、やっぱり同時代の有名作品と比べると見劣りするかも。ただ、３ｒｄでは味方・敵合わせて登場キャラクター数が多く、必殺技演出も多彩になる。
blocks.translation: The battle effects put in a decent effort, but they may still look inferior compared with famous games from the same era. However, the 3rd features a large number of playable and enemy characters, along with a greater variety of special-move effects.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: あまりＰＣゲームをやらない僕だけど、ファルコム作品の音楽評価の高さは良く耳にするところ。もちろん、この作品も例外ではなし。本作では特に一部ボス戦などで流れる「銀の意志」や３ｒｄのラスボス戦曲の評価が高い。
blocks.translation: I do not play many PC games, but I often hear about the high regard for the music in Nihon Falcom’s works. This game is no exception, of course. In particular, “Silver Will,” which plays during some boss battles, and the final boss theme from the 3rd are highly acclaimed.

blocks.source: あえてケチを付ければ、通常ボス戦曲が地味なのと、ダンジョン曲などに同じモチーフを使いすぎている点。でも、さすがに贅沢言い過ぎかも。
blocks.translation: If I had to nitpick, I would say that the regular boss battle theme is rather subdued and that the same motifs are used too often in dungeon themes and the like. But perhaps that is asking for too much.

blocks.source: その他
blocks.translation: Other

blocks.source: 筆者はＰＣ版でプレイしたが、今はＰＳＰにも移植されている模様。内容に多少の差異もあるようなので、興味がある人はご確認を。
blocks.translation: I played the PC version, but it appears to have since been ported to the PSP as well. There seem to be some differences in the content, so if you're interested, please check it out.
